entity.meta_description: The Helicopter Company (THC) is a Saudi Public Investment Fund subsidiary. Signed MoUs with Archer Aviation and Joby Aviation in November 2025 for Saudi eVTOL sandbox testing. CEO Captain Arnaud Martinez.
